title: Recipe developer and tester
summary: Develop and test tiffin recipes in your own kitchen, including how each one holds up after four hours in a tin. Regional specialities and Jain cooking are a plus.

title: Food photographer and short-video creator
summary: Shoot recipe stills and 30 to 60 second vertical videos for the site, YouTube and Instagram.

title: City partnerships lead
summary: Sign up local tiffin kitchens, verify their registration and menus, and keep city guides accurate.

title: Food and small-business writer
summary: Write practical guides for tiffin customers and kitchen owners, with sources and real numbers.

title: Community and challenge moderator
summary: Review monthly challenge entries, run the judging rota and answer readers.

title: Kitchen onboarding sales
summary: Bring tiffin kitchens onto featured listings and matched-lead plans. Experience selling to restaurants or caterers helps.
